subject: Ciências
description_pt: Identificar diferentes tipos de rocha, relacionando a formação de fósseis a rochas sedimentares em diferentes períodos geológicos.

components.description_pt: Identificar diferentes tipos de rochas e suas características definidoras
components.description_en: Identify different types of rocks and their defining characteristics

components.description_pt: Relacionar formação de rochas sedimentares à preservação de fósseis
components.description_en: Relate sedimentary rock formation to the preservation of fossils
components.cc_component_description: Explain how the location and type of fossils within rock layers indicate the sequence of layer formation

components.description_pt: Associar registros fósseis com períodos geológicos específicos e camadas de rochas sedimentares
components.description_en: Associate fossil records with specific geological periods and sedimentary rock layers
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the distribution of fossils across rock layers to determine relative age of organisms

cc_matches.description: Local, regional, and global patterns of rock formations reveal changes over time due to earth forces, such as earthquakes. The presence and location of certain fossil types indicate the order in which rock layers were formed.
Fossils provide evidence about the types of organisms that lived long ago and also about the nature of their environments.
